title: Russian intake interpretation and resolution evaluation draft
status: authored from user-provided cases; numeric fixture values pending
evaluation_layers: interpretation: classify the message, normalize wording, extract quantities and references
resolution: select the expected user-scoped recipe, product, historical entry, or clarification
application: calculate using pinned fixture sources, persist only authorized resolved items, and update totals

fixture_contract.catalog: Synthetic catalog entries named in each case must have pinned kcal/macro values and preparation/basis metadata.
fixture_contract.recipes: Named saved recipes must have a current immutable nutrition version.
fixture_contract.profile: The coffee-as-usual rule and the short post-meal grouping window are explicit per-user fixtures.
fixture_contract.history: Cases that use a prior food reference or an existing meal declare the required owner-scoped history.
fixture_contract.numeric_oracle: Exact kcal and macro assertions are generated from the pinned fixture sources; this corpus does not invent nutrition values.
